text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During a break from training at summer camp…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, the ocean breeze blowing in from beyond the horizon.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And… I'm listening to the voices of the winds that wander the seas.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: They echo on and on across this beach—sometimes quietly, sometimes fiercely.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If only for a moment at a time, the wind and those sounds calm my heart as it pounds in anticipation of the coming contest.
choice_data_list: Mind if I listen with you?
Mind if I listen with you?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Not at all. There are all kinds of voices, so no matter how long I listen, I never get tired of them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I stand next to Yamanin Zephyr for some time, feeling the wind on my face as we listen to the sound of the waves. Until…
Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Let's hang out! I wanna do a two-on-two battle with you, me, Ikuno, and Nature!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The lively student who just turned up is the highly energetic runner, Twin Turbo. Her friends follow a little behind her.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the trouble. It seems that Turbo gets extra excited when she visits the beach.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, sorry about that. C'mon, Turbo. We're heading back now.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Don't wanna! We can't do a team battle with just three people! I wanna do a two-on-two! Two-on-twooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even if it's just for fun, competing with others might be more stimulating than training alone.
choice_data_list: …Just out of curiosity, what kind of "battle" were you thinking of?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Well, we could do a relay, or a water gun shootout, or a game of cops and robbers!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: We could also do beach flags or volleyball. Or, for something a bit different, we could try a game of sandslide to test our strategic thinking…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: In this heat, it's probably best to do something involving the sand and water. Besides, whatever we do will make for good training.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Interesting. So it'd be a contest that serves as training, too?
choice_data_list: Want to join for a bit?
Want to join for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Yes, perhaps this is another opportune airstream.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'd like to accept your offer. I'll assume it signals an auspicious updraft approaching, and that it'll lift me higher still.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Okay, okay, so what are we gonna play?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hmm, let's see… Which game do you think would invite the most roseate currents, Trainer?
choice_data_list: A relay on the sand to build running strength.
Sandslide, to help you when it comes down to the line!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: In that case, I'll become a fiery gust sweeping across the sand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the game decided, Yamanin Zephyr and Nice Nature go up against Twin Turbo and Ikuno Dictus in a team relay race.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: All right, Ikuno, you be the anchor! And I'll score us a huuuge lead first!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Our success is in your hands. Please pace yourself properly.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You just leave the second half of the relay to me. I won't let you down, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If I can channel a cyclone as I run, then the winds of victory are sure to blow.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Give it all you've got, Zephyr! Keep it up and widen your lead!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Pant! Pant! N-nooo! I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Turbo… Still, this development was expected. The larger their lead, the higher the chance they'll get careless.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (The sand has more give than I was expecting! …But I know I can do this!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (I need to let the wind carry my legs—I need to take flight!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, wait! Where are you heading, Zephyr?! You're going too far!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: She truly runs like a gust of wind…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still full of energy after the relay race, they also enjoy beach flags, volleyball, and a few more games, switching teams as they go.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahh, sandslide, huh? All right, everyone, here's how it works: we're gonna put a stick in a mound of sand, and take turns scooping away at it. Whoever causes the stick to fall loses.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The key to victory lies in remaining calm and following a strategy. We must make our hearts still.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Twin Turbo and Yamanin Zephyr go head-to-head with Nice Nature and Ikuno Dictus in a team battle.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yeeeah! Turbo swoooop!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What?! You're scooping away too much, too fast! The sand mound looks like some kind of sand candle now!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: …It didn't collapse. That was an audacious move, but not one made in error.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That said, now that the structure's been thinned out, its center of balance has become apparent. The safe zone is riiight… here!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Wha?! It looks like an apple core! Can you actually pull this off, Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I will still my heart, and envision a way forward…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (…I need to read the flow of both the sand and the ocean breeze.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Sandy apple core… The direction of your wind is…)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: This way!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! No way! I thought we had this in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I did it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still full of energy after sandslide, they also enjoy beach flags, volleyball, and a few more games, switching teams as they go.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Aw, geez! We lost the set!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Feinting a deep spike only to attack right by the net… Very impressive.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I simply followed the sea breeze's guidance.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And just now… I felt an auspicious updraft blowing my way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the games continue, the sun slips away unnoticed.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: As much as I'd like to stay longer, I think it's about time we headed back to camp.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Thanks for hanging out with us all day. Today wouldn't have been anywhere near as fun without you.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Let's play again sometime, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's. When a fresh breeze blows again…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Whew. I didn't even notice the sun setting. I'm a little tired…
choice_data_list: It was nice to see you enjoying yourself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Before I knew it, there were countless winds blowing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: One a gallant gale, another a frenetic storm, and one a comforting zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: All these memories were brought by the ocean breeze. I doubt I'll forget them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A day of play in the middle of camp turns out to be a much-needed break for Yamanin Zephyr.
